policy.local_anchor_rule: highest finite component_local_habitat_score with stable candidate-id tie break; missing local score ranks below finite values
policy.rescue_model_target: candidate fraction of all held-out occurrences covered within 10 km that remain uncovered by the single local anchor
policy.selection_tie_break: higher diversity-adjusted rescue score, then higher raw predicted rescue gain, then higher local score, then stable candidate/site id

inference_features.numeric_preprocess: median imputation then standard scaling within model training set
inference_features.categorical_preprocess: one-hot encoding with unknown categories ignored

development_design.model_selection_validation: 8-fold GroupKFold by complete taxon-region pair; every candidate prediction comes from a model excluding its pair
development_design.locked_extension_role: apply the unchanged 48-pair-selected policy after fitting on all 48 model-selection pairs; do not use extension outcomes to choose features, model or policy
development_design.note: the former SDM cohort is no longer confirmatory for ACSP because its outcomes were previously inspected for another comparison; it is used only as a locked extension development set for this new policy

model_selection_result.warning: development/model-selection evidence only; all policy choices above were selected before the locked 24-pair extension evaluation

development_gate.combined_gate: 72-pair mean gain >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
development_gate.extension_guardrail: report the 24-pair locked-extension gain separately; reversal or material failure blocks freezing a final all-72 model
development_gate.next_gate: after this gate, refit the unchanged model on all 72 development pairs and compare the fixed policy against official spsurvey::grts proportional-local + requested 10-km mindis on development candidate pools before any new confirmation cohort is sampled
